name: matchy-campus
description: AI-first campus placement portal with agentic chat, job feed, resume lab and QR attendance

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && cd ai-service && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && cd ai-service && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q
